cars.rule: Use class-level silhouette and proportion cues only; omit branding and exact production trade dress.

boats.rule: Treat the three existing hull classes as one placement pool. Add a second superstructure variant only for any class repeated frequently enough to expose duplication.

entries.name: ACE Hardware
entries.baselineBrief: A broad shed-roof civic hall with a chamfered corner tower, four covered edge porches, and a heavy rectangular plinth that reads as a robust illustrative capital.

entries.name: Column Technologies
entries.baselineBrief: A vertical colonnaded capital with five slender structural fins rising above a low transverse hall, joined by one recessed roof bridge and a narrow stepped forecourt.

entries.name: Independent
entries.baselineBrief: An asymmetric maker capital composed of a broad sawtooth workshop, a narrow archive tower, and a small pavilion grouped around an open triangular courtyard.

entries.name: NinjaOne
entries.baselineBrief: An octagonal command hall with a stepped central beacon tower, three low radial annexes, and a clipped diamond footprint; civic, compact, and visibly distinct from every project building.

entries.name: Tanium
entries.baselineBrief: A long low civic spine enclosing a rectangular forum, capped by two unequal offset observation towers and deep stepped corner buttresses.

entries.name: Atlassian Data Center Resilience
entries.baselineBrief: An entertainment-only resilience landmark: one low U-shaped fortified mass wraps a deep open courtyard, with alternating solid buttress bays, a single sloped roof datum, and two low utility pods physically joined to the inner U arms by solid ground-level service necks.

entries.name: Atlassian Platform Automation
entries.baselineBrief: An entertainment-only platform landmark: a broad inverted stepped-pyramid volume narrows to a compact central base, stabilized by four low connected buttress arms and cut by one deep diagonal roof notch.

entries.name: CableCar
entries.baselineBrief: Two sharply different terminal towers stand across a narrow gap, joined by a high enclosed service bridge with a shallow catenary lower chord and a narrow maintenance rail tucked inside the bridge envelope.

entries.name: Career World Portfolio
entries.baselineBrief: A tiered cartographer pavilion forms an open folded-map roof around a central navigable courtyard, with three viewpoint decks and a narrow inset evidence gallery.

entries.name: Client DevOps Delivery Implementations
entries.baselineBrief: An entertainment-only implementation cairn: four irregular interlocked wedge blocks climb around a narrow vertical void on a five-sided podium, with one broad cantilevered cap that shifts the skyline off-center.

entries.name: ContextForge
entries.baselineBrief: An L-shaped heavy fabrication hall carries a bank of sawtooth roof vaults, a tall offset archive tower, and one diagonal overhead transfer bridge that lands on a compact cylindrical compression house.

entries.name: Kaizen Agent Platform
entries.baselineBrief: Three interlocked stepped workshop bars surround a guarded central transfer bay; a narrow overhead gate bridge and a compact rollback side vault create a controlled, reversible silhouette.

entries.name: Kaizen Metrics
entries.baselineBrief: A terraced analytics refinery combines a low sawtooth ingestion hall, a raised linear compute spine, a cylindrical query reservoir, and one small faceted assistant lightwell.

entries.name: QC ALM Extractor
entries.baselineBrief: An entertainment-only extractor landmark: two leaning clamp towers suspend one plain faceted block above a stepped quarry-like base with a short rear service ramp.

entries.name: SAP Table Update Integration
entries.baselineBrief: An entertainment-only table landmark: a broad elevated grid deck rests on four heavy corner piers above a centered mechanical lift and a narrow transfer bridge.

entries.name: T-Match / EOLMatch
entries.baselineBrief: One squat diamond adjudication tower is built from two interlocking stair-stepped masses, divided by a deep zigzag roof seam and finished by a single narrow rear archive fin.

entries.name: Tanium Risk Assessment
entries.baselineBrief: A diagonal escarpment of three interlocked wedge halls steps upward toward one cantilevered audit tower, cut by a deep zigzag inspection trench and anchored by a low triangular forecourt.

entries.name: Ticket Validation Automation
entries.baselineBrief: An entertainment-only ticket-gate pavilion: a perforated folded canopy spans a row of abstract turnstile-like ribs and one tall inspection arch on a wedge-shaped platform.

entries.name: UAT Automation
entries.baselineBrief: An elongated test hall contains a rhythm of enclosed validation chambers between two dissimilar endpoint pavilions, crossed by one raised control mezzanine.

entries.name: Vendy VM Platform
entries.baselineBrief: Twin unequal service towers flank a sunken orchestration dock, with a branching overhead gantry, a low operator kiosk, and a broad trapezoidal equipment apron.

entries.name: xSearch
entries.baselineBrief: A long indexing-comb hall uses six parallel archive fins of staggered length beneath one transverse raised query bridge, with an off-center triangular reading tower at the closed end.

entries.name: AI
entries.baselineBrief: A non-agentic analytical instrument pavilion centers on one long horizontal faceted calibration drum seated in two unequal structural cradles, crossed by a narrow transverse measurement gallery and balanced by a low rectangular service annex in a linear asymmetric footprint.

entries.name: Atlassian
entries.baselineBrief: A single continuous chevron-plan civic hall forms two unequal wedge wings around a narrow open forecourt, with stepped roof terraces rising toward the joined apex and one low rear archive strip.

entries.name: AWS
entries.baselineBrief: A distributed utility campus of three small service pavilions around one taller hub, joined at ground level by broad solid causeways and a clipped perimeter base.

entries.name: C#
entries.baselineBrief: A six-sided precision toolhouse carries an asymmetric sawtooth roof, a low side compilation bay, and two deep corner cuts in its faceted plinth.

entries.name: CI/CD
entries.baselineBrief: An elongated fabrication hall is wrapped by a continuous elevated service track and terminates in two sequential release bays with different roof heights.

entries.name: Context compression
entries.baselineBrief: Four freestanding rectangular frames decrease in span and height toward one dense central core, all seated on a tapered trapezoidal base.

entries.name: Data contracts
entries.baselineBrief: Twin archive halls with different roof pitches connect only through a narrow sealed validation gate, creating a pronounced central pinch in the footprint.

entries.name: Databricks
entries.baselineBrief: A stepped processing quarry descends through four staggered slab terraces to a narrow central work court, bounded by a single high rear retaining hall.

entries.name: Docker
entries.baselineBrief: A modular yard building stacks rectangular service bays beneath a tall open gantry frame, with a broad loading plinth and one side stair tower.

entries.name: Electron
entries.baselineBrief: A lightweight outer frame cradles a smaller solid workspace volume, separated by a continuous air gap and anchored by one low desktop-like base slab without screen details.

entries.name: Go
entries.baselineBrief: A long low double-gable workshop wraps a straight open service spine, with one clipped corner loading bay and a short raised rear monitor shed.

entries.name: Informatica
entries.baselineBrief: Three distinct intake halls converge through solid angled corridors into one raised transformation chamber, then leave through a single narrow exit dock.

entries.name: Java
entries.baselineBrief: A stable long-span runtime hall with a raised central service tower, a continuous perimeter colonnade, and two low cross-platform side wings.

entries.name: LocalDB
entries.baselineBrief: A compact sunken archive bunker leaves only a small offset intake pavilion and two low ventilation ridges above a thick square base.

entries.name: MacStadium
entries.baselineBrief: An elongated managed-compute hall sits on a deep plinth with a rhythm of narrow service bays, a detached parallel utility bridge, and one raised end tower.

entries.name: Manifest V3
entries.baselineBrief: A three-tier logistics ledger tower steps upward from a broad sorting hall to a narrow cap, with one exterior verification ramp touching every tier.
entries.exclusionReason: Resume coverage is too small to justify a dedicated Career World building.

entries.name: MCP
entries.baselineBrief: A square protocol exchange tower with four unequal orthogonal docking bays, a recessed central roof court, and one diagonal maintenance stair.

entries.name: OpenAPI
entries.baselineBrief: Two tall open portal frames bracket a compact specification vault, with branching solid ramps and a long shallow rear canopy.

entries.name: Operator control
entries.baselineBrief: A raised faceted control cabin sits above a broad stepped plinth, reached by two exposed switchback ramps and backed by a low counterweight hall.

entries.name: PostgreSQL
entries.baselineBrief: A stout cylindrical archive silo is wrapped by a partial helical service ramp and four radial buttresses, anchored to a compact octagonal base.

entries.name: Python
entries.baselineBrief: Two offset curved-edge automation halls flank a straight diagonal service spine, with one square intake court and one raised rear utility loft.

entries.name: React
entries.baselineBrief: Three cascading terrace wings turn around an open central stage, with one low rear service bar and offset roof planes that make a pinwheel footprint without orbital curves.

entries.name: Redis
entries.baselineBrief: A low zigzag cache pavilion is made from five interlocking ground-level slab cells, crossed by one short diagonal bypass bridge and terminated by a compact cylindrical service drum.

entries.name: Safe writes
entries.baselineBrief: A low gated archive block with a two-stage entry airlock, a recessed central write chamber, and a detached-looking but structurally joined rollback side vault.
entries.exclusionReason: Implementation detail does not warrant a dedicated Career World building.

entries.name: TypeScript
entries.baselineBrief: Three slim prismatic shafts of unequal height are bound by one diagonal brace above a square compiler hall with a recessed side court.

entries.name: VMware
entries.baselineBrief: Two stacked offset machine floors float visually above one heavy shared physical base, tied by an exposed side core and a recessed service court.

entries.name: Workflow orchestration
entries.baselineBrief: A circular conductor rotunda with a tall central drum, six staggered low service bays, and one interrupted ring ramp that creates a readable radial silhouette.

entries.name: Cargo Boat
entries.baselineBrief: A low angular barge with a raised stern cabin, open central cargo well, blunt bow, and two simple side rub rails.

entries.name: City Shuttle
entries.baselineBrief: A coordinated civic transit family with at least two distinct silhouettes: a short low-floor neighborhood shuttle and a longer single-body city bus, sharing wheel scale, doorway language, restrained roof equipment, and map-readable passenger volumes without operator markings.
entries.iterationDirective: Replace the single short-shuttle batch with a small transit family so repeated road traffic does not reuse one bus silhouette.

entries.name: Commuter Car
entries.baselineBrief: A coherent three-member personal car family at one map scale: a short-wheelbase upright open utility 4x4 inspired by 1994 Wrangler proportions, a compact Honda Civic-inspired daily driver with generation and body style still to be specified, and a wide sport sedan inspired by 2018 WRX proportions. Preserve recognizable class-level silhouettes without logos, badges, exact grilles, exact lamps, or one-to-one production geometry.
entries.iterationDirective: Replace the current single generic four-door batch with a coordinated three-vehicle family. Each member must remain an independently placeable asset while sharing projection, wheel scale, line density, and grayscale material treatment.

entries.name: Delivery Van
entries.baselineBrief: A compact last-mile delivery van with a tall enclosed cargo body, short cab, two side access zones, and a clipped rectangular footprint.

entries.name: Evergreen Cluster
entries.baselineBrief: One reusable clustered prop identity: three angular evergreen forms of unequal height overlap on a single low faceted ground plate while retaining clear individual trunks.

variantKitPolicy.reason: Low-detail vegetation should use an interchangeable silhouette set rather than a tournament winner.

entries.name: Harbor Ferry
entries.baselineBrief: A compact twin-hull passenger ferry with a low central cabin, open foredeck, protected boarding edges, and a stable map-readable silhouette.

entries.name: Marker Buoy
entries.baselineBrief: A faceted weighted buoy body supports a narrow mast, a small open top cage, and two opposing stabilizer fins on a compact diamond footprint.

variantKitPolicy.reason: Navigation markers are low-detail world dressing and should vary automatically.

entries.name: Rail Tram
entries.baselineBrief: A single articulated map-scale tram with two short passenger sections, a flexible center joint, visible bogies, and restrained roof hardware.

variantKitPolicy.reason: Rail traffic needs several interchangeable map-scale consists but does not need art-direction review.

entries.name: Rock Cluster
entries.baselineBrief: One reusable cluster of five faceted boulders: one tall split slab, two medium wedges, and two low chips on a compact irregular base.

variantKitPolicy.reason: Low-detail rocks should use an interchangeable formation set rather than a tournament winner.

entries.name: Roof Equipment Kit
entries.baselineBrief: One canonical grouped roof kit containing a low rectangular housing, an angled vent hood, a three-pipe cluster, and a narrow access curb arranged on one shared base.

variantKitPolicy.reason: Roof equipment is supporting detail and should be assembled from a reusable variation kit.

entries.name: Service Truck
entries.baselineBrief: A compact cab-over utility truck with an enclosed rear service body, one shallow roof rack, exposed wheel arches, and a clipped rectangular footprint.

entries.name: Shore Pier
entries.baselineBrief: A T-shaped shore pier with a long narrow pile-supported approach, broad cross-head deck, one tiny blank utility shelter, and stepped shoreline abutment.

variantKitPolicy.reason: Piers are repeated shoreline infrastructure and need footprint variation without tournament review.

entries.name: Street Furniture Kit
entries.baselineBrief: One reusable civic prop kit containing a lamp, bench, two bollards, a small waste bin, and a low planter arranged on a shared paving plate.

variantKitPolicy.reason: Street furniture is low-detail civic dressing and should ship as interchangeable prop groupings.

entries.name: Work Skiff
entries.baselineBrief: A small practical utility skiff with an open work deck, compact aft control shelter, reinforced bow, and simple rub rails.
